drafts.angle: ChatGPT profiles need a compliance check (rides @gregisenberg's 'Google My Business moment for AI', the most-saved post of the day)
drafts.draft_en:
OpenAI just let every business claim a profile inside ChatGPT.

This is the Google My Business moment for AI. And ads are coming with it.

Here's what nobody's saying yet: everything a brand puts in front of an AI assistant is now advertising.

The claims in your profile. The offers. The before/after language.

Same FTC rules. Same brand rules. New surface, a lot less human review.

At Aubric we check creative against brand, legal, and platform rules before it ships. ChatGPT is just the newest platform on the list.
drafts.video_tip: 30s vertical talking head. Hook in the first 2 seconds: 'Every business just got a ChatGPT profile.' Cut to a mock profile with three claims highlighted, then run them through Aubric: one APPROVE, one FIX ('clinically proven' needs substantiation), one BLOCK. End card: 'New surface. Same rules.' Post it while the ChatGPT profiles news is still trending this week.

drafts.angle: 0.0% prompt injection is the stat; the ad review version (rides @gregisenberg's 7-day Gemini 4 Carbon early observations and @rauchg's security scoreboard)
drafts.draft_en:
Two stats from this week's model launches stuck with me:

Prompt injection success rate: 0.0%.
Agent shortcuts on benchmarks: 0.0%.

We're finally getting models you can leave alone with a codebase.

Now do the same for your ads.

If an agent ships 100 ads overnight, you need a reviewer that runs overnight too: every ad checked against brand, legal, and platform policy, with a verdict and the exact rule cited.

That's what we're building at Aubric.
drafts.video_tip: 20s vertical with on-screen numbers: '0.0%' slams in twice with the two labels, then a third line types out: 'Ads shipped overnight without review: ?' Cut to an Aubric dashboard showing an overnight batch with approve, fix, and block counts. Use a checkmark scoreboard layout like @rauchg's launch-week numbers.

drafts.angle: One-sentence reframe for founders (rides @AlexHormozi's 'no one cares about you as much as you think they do', the most-liked post of the day)
drafts.draft_en:
Nobody cares about your ad as much as you think they do.

Except the platform's policy team. And your client's legal team. And the FTC.

They care a lot.
drafts.video_tip: 10s text-on-screen post, no voiceover: line one holds for 3 seconds, then the three 'except' lines stack one at a time with a beat between each. Keep it native and plain, like the Hormozi one-liners that are winning; no logo until a small 'Aubric' tag in the final frame.
